header.name: Miguel de Mendoza
header.title: Motion Graphics and Full Stack Developer

sections.title: Profile
sections.content: Motion Grapher and Full Stack Developer with over 10 years combining software development and audiovisual design. Expert in Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Django, Vue.js, and TypeScript, with a focus on artificial intelligence and automation. In the last year, I designed a system in Extendscript and CEP that reduced video editing times from 5-6 hours to 1 hour per piece. Certified by IBM in AI, I bring technical creativity, analytical skills, and scalable solutions to innovative projects.

content.text:
Camera Operator and Video Editor - Vocational Business Training Courses (Mar 2024 - Mar 2025)
Recorded and edited audiovisual content for business courses, ensuring high visual and narrative quality.
Developed a system in Extendscript and Adobe CEP to automate editing in Adobe Premiere and After Effects, reducing time per piece from 5-6 hours to 1 hour (80% efficiency improvement).

Freelance Post-Production Developer (Oct 2016 - Apr 2019)
Created scripts in JavaScript and ExtendScript to optimize post-production workflows, saving 30% in delivery times.
Designed interactive interfaces with Vue.js and Adobe CEP for animation projects, enhancing usability and client experience.

Creative Director and R&D at TVA (2014 - 2015)
Supervised the creation of visual content (videos, web design) and led a creative team of 5 people.
Implemented algorithms in Python and OpenCV for social media analysis and facial detection, integrated into marketing strategies.

Motion Graphics Designer at Lucky Road (Sept - Oct 2016)
Automated the generation of graphics for “Boca-zas” (Disney Channel) with Extendscript, delivering over 50 assets in one month under tight deadlines.

KT Extendscript Builder (In development)
Developing a CLI with Vite and Rollup to transpile TypeScript to Extendscript, enabling After Effects and Premiere developers to use the latest JavaScript features in their scripts, saving significant development time.

LTTR (Predictive Lottery) (In development)
Backend in Django/Django REST Framework for automated scraping of lottery results (Euromillions, Primitiva).
Trained AI models with TensorFlow and ResNets to predict outcomes, achieving a scalable data pipeline.
Frontend in Vue.js to manage scraping, training, and metrics visualization.

Plainetarium
Application to generate planets and spheres in HTML and CSS, producing ready-to-use code for web projects.
Frontend in Vue.js with interactive visualizations, optimized for real-time performance.

Fretboard Master Application for learning guitar scales and chords with an interactive fretboard.
Developed with Vue.js and Vuetify

AE Pseudo UI
Landing page to showcase the integration of my tools into the After Effects interface. Developed with Astro and React
